visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young people are seated on a light grey sofa in front of a clean, white wall. On the left, a male in a blue denim shirt. In the middle, a male with blonde hair wearing a black hoodie with yellow smiley face patches. On the right, a female wearing a beige shirt and a grey knitted beanie. They are clapping their hands in a synchronized rhythm while looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a new round where the blonde male in the middle is now wearing a white and green striped shirt. They continue the rhythmic clapping. When a mistake is made, they all burst into laughter, leaning towards each other. A red handbag graphic appears on screen during a specific word. (3) Back to the blonde male wearing the black hoodie. They are playing the game again with high energy, smiling and nodding to the beat. The female on the right covers her mouth as she laughs. Yellow text bubbles appear at the top of the frame for each category. (4) Another cut shows the blonde male in a white and green striped shirt again. They are clapping faster. The individuals use hand gestures like pointing or touching their hair as they think of words. The lighting is bright and even studio light. (5) The blonde male is seen wearing a black t-shirt in a later round. They are in the same living room setting. The participants are leaning forward, engaged in the fast-paced verbal game. When the round ends, a graphic transition effect like yellow sparks or white lines appears over the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A crisp, rhythmic hand-clapping sound begins, creating a steady 4/4 time signature. A male voice leads with a prompt in Mandarin, followed by two other voices speaking in rapid succession. The tone is cheerful and high-energy. Subtle electronic synthesizer beats underscore the clapping. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect occurs, coinciding with a visual graphic. This is immediately followed by the collective laughter of three individuals—two male, one female. The laughter is natural but bright, indicating high positive valence. (3) A digital 'stinger' or whoosh transition sound signals the end of a round and the start of another. The clapping rhythm restarts instantly without a break in tempo. Vocal pitch shifts higher as excitement increases. (4) A loud, comedic buzzer sound indicates an incorrect answer. The voices erupt into loud chatter and laughing. The acoustic environment is clean with minimal room resonance, typical of a treated studio space. (5) The final segment features overlapping voices talking excitedly. The clapping continues as a background percussive layer. The music swells slightly with a playful melody before a final hard cut to silence.
